summaryFa: وقتی مبل در راهرو گیر می‌کند، رفتار آرام یک نفر به دو همراهش سرایت می‌کند.
storyFa: سه نفر هنگام جابه‌جایی، مبلی را در راهرو گیر انداخته‌اند. دو نفر با استرس به جهت‌های مختلف اشاره می‌کنند، اما آبی آرام مکث می‌دهد. در ادامه هر سه با همان شانه‌های رها و حرکات آهسته، مبل را روی زمین می‌گذارند و قبل از حرکت بعدی با هم هماهنگ می‌شوند.
meaningFa: آرام‌بودن به معنی بی‌عملی نیست؛ رفتار آرامِ آبی به جمع کمک می‌کند از تقلا و فشار متقابل به همکاری برسند.
english: Calm is contagious. Be calm to help others.
persian: آرامش مسریه. آروم باش تا به بقیه هم کمک کنی.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: one complete finished square watercolor illustration for an illustrated Persian translation of Kevin Kelly's adult advice book. Depict the meaning of "Calm is contagious. Be calm to help others." This English sentence must not appear inside the artwork.
Input image: the supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its character family, face treatment, layered watercolor paint and clear visual storytelling, while drawing the entirely new situation below. Do not copy its carpenter, furniture shop, apron, dialogue or panel count.
Visual style: genuine hand-painted, moderately layered transparent watercolor on white textured paper. Show uneven translucent washes, gentle pigment pooling and overlapping color shapes inside the heads AND bodies, not only around the outer border. Natural irregular watercolor margins leave clean white paper all around. Warm, humane, artistically composed, readable at a glance. Neither flat vector nor wax crayon, marker, colored pencil, shiny plastic or 3D render. Contours are thin darkened local body colors, never black outlines. Subtle deeper local-color crescent immediately under each head separates head and torso; no visible neck.
Character design: simple adult neutral figures, genuinely circular heads of equal width and height, soft slender-to-medium adult limbs and balanced proportions like the reference, never chubby arms, bulbous bodies, very thin stick bodies or chibi proportions. Every figure shares the SAME neutral torso silhouette: no breasts, hips, waist indentation, buttock emphasis, hairstyle or selective clothes. A female character may have ONLY two tiny curved eyelashes attached to the usual eye shape. Eyes are small dark vertical ovals with at most a tiny white highlight; no white sclera or altered eye structure. Minimal brows and warm expressive mouths. Every fully visible hand has exactly three fingers and one thumb; naturally occluded fingers may remain hidden. Full bodies and significant objects remain safely inside the art. No special clothing is necessary. Stable character color and identity throughout all panels: emotions change through face and posture, never by changing a character's body color.
Reading: if multiple panels are described, read right to left, with discreet white gutters and no heavy boxes. Preserve the same location and props between the story beats. Maintain simple spatial continuity and clearly related cause and effect. The calm BLUE figure models calm, rather than merely smiling indifferently; the others visibly become calmer and repeat its approach. The underlying inconvenience need not vanish. Render only the explicitly listed short Persian dialogue, accurately and legibly in the bubble assigned to its speaker. No English, explanatory paragraph, panel labels, numbers, logos or watermark.

Story and composition:
Composition: a square page with TWO horizontal watercolor panels showing exactly the same broad apartment corridor and doorway at the same viewpoint. One modest two-seat sofa, BLUE, RED and VIOLET adults. Sofa is safe and lightweight; no injury, crushed fingers or precarious staircase. Full people, hands and sofa fit entirely inside the page. Do not show workers' uniforms or special clothing.
TOP: the sofa sits diagonally and is awkwardly stuck at the doorway; floor contact is clear. RED and VIOLET have raised tense shoulders and frowning brows, each making an unhelpful small pointing gesture in a different direction. BLUE faces them calmly, both feet firmly on the floor and one open palm gently lowered, suggesting a pause, not shushing or scolding. Its only bubble reads exactly: «آروم، با هم.» Make BLUE's influence empathetic and concrete; all look toward each other, not toward the viewer.
BOTTOM: same sofa, same doorway, same people and body colors. The sofa remains resting on the floor at the doorway; the problem is not magically solved. All three have now let their shoulders drop and copied BLUE's slow, coordinated posture. BLUE crouches gently at one end and gestures a small rotation; RED at the other end looks directly at BLUE with an understanding relaxed expression, and VIOLET looks between them with a calm open palm echoing BLUE's earlier gesture. They agree on the next move without fighting or straining. The sofa can be slightly rotated to make the shared plan visible, but keep one clear coherent object, not intersecting walls. Mild humor in how the formerly bossy RED now carefully copies the little calming hand gesture. No additional text.
Framing: pull back in each panel enough to show every full character, all feet, all furniture and a strip of floor beneath. Natural table/counter occlusion is allowed but no body part is cut by the panel border. Reduce all subjects to fit the wide scene inside each of the two panels.

preflight.meaning: Calm spreads through modeled relaxed behavior and helps other adults; external inconvenience remains visible.
preflight.legibility: Few characters; two directly continuous panels; concrete actions and posture changes.
preflight.style: Approved character family, circular heads, identical neutral adult torsos, local-color outlines, watercolor bodies, no white sclera.

qa.storyAndCauseEffect: Red and Violet initially point in opposite directions at the doorway. Blue requests calm; in the lower panel both have relaxed and watch Blue coordinate a small sofa rotation. The same sofa remains at the same doorway, resting safely on its feet.
qa.styleObserved: Moderate layered watercolor in circular heads and neutral adult bodies, dark local-color contours, no white eye sclera, consistent identity/colors.
qa.framingObserved: All visible body portions and feet are inside the panels; Red lower body is naturally occluded behind the sofa. A small unlettered curved arrow clarifies the planned rotation.

rootVisualReview.notes: Viewed actual final PNG: same sofa and doorway; red and purple stop contradictory pointing after calm blue intervenes, then coordinate with relaxed faces. Sofa remains grounded; same identities and complete bodies within frame.
